name: A chance on hit weapon without a PPM rate does not proc on every hit (#10794)
contract: Report #10794: Flamefist Claw and similar weapons cast their chance on hit effect on every swing. Flamefist Claw (410179) has no spellppmRate and its proc (201134) carries DBC ProcChance 100, which Player::CastItemCombatSpell used as the chance. Stock uses 101 for the weapon-speed fallback; 321 Ascension items store 100.

Expected: without a PPM rate a ProcChance of 100 or more uses the weapon proc chance (2.5 s x 1.8 = 4.5%). Eight minutes of auto attacks (about 190 swings) average about eight procs: at least one (zero has odds below 0.1%) and at most 20, where the old behaviour cast it on almost every landed swing.

steps.label: SETUP: the claw swings every 2.5 s
DISCRIMINATING: the proc fires on some swings, not every one
